description: Baseline: terrain objects (tree/pine/house/rock/flower/boat/bush) placed via biome rules, shown in all view modes. 3D view: richer sky gradient with clouds, varied surface textures per biome and distance, depth fog, terrain objects as vertical elements. ISO view: objects with trunks, south-face column shading, varied surface glyphs. 2D views: objects shown as coloured glyphs.
